The MASTER_QUEUE carries legalInputStatus SETTLED, which VERMONT_REPAIR itself records as the Captain-side error that produced this filing-ready packet. A packet that tells a participant how to file when the law does not resolve whether they may file yet cannot pass, however mechanically complete.
